runs.summary: This run was driven by a fixed script (model "scripted", zero tokens), not a GPT model, on the into-basket, out and stand-upright task with a budget of 8 steps. runs.summary: The model had to stand up a bottle lying on the table. It aligned the gripper at yaw 55 and missed its first close because it was too high (z=65). It spent three steps on reverse-tilt moves that were out of reach, and finally reused the original placement pose.
